India and Pakistan Women's Cricket Teams Set for Asia Cup Match

The Indian and Pakistani women's cricket teams are scheduled to compete in the Women's Asia Cup 2026. India has a strong historical advantage, having won 10 of their last 11 encounters against Pakistan. Ahead of the match, Pakistan opener Ayesha Zafar downplayed the significance of the clash, referring to it as 'just another game'. The event is set to take place in Dubai.
